purpose: Admit or reject one final structurally distinct optimizer family before fitting any cost model.
fixed_obligation: record-level lineage for every output row
semantic_requirements: Every candidate returns identical ordered visible rows for every batch query.
Every candidate returns the same 32-byte ordinal-bound source identities in the same order.
No checkpoint materializes raw source identifiers.
Source-level lineage is not accepted as a substitute for record-level lineage.
anti_fishing_rule: This is the final new optimizer family. If semantic equivalence or later winner-diversity admission fails, retain the negative result and stop adding query families.
next_step_if_semantics_pass: Freeze a paired winner-diversity timing grid before observing formal latency.
